title: Hunts FH-046T: Sign-off, approver screen and live acceptance run for Trail gifts

source.ref: Split from FH-046S (2026-11-16): the gift mirror and the gated ask shipped dark; what an agent cannot do moved here.

detail: Requires FH-045 (the D8 beneficiary and sponsor model, a human legal and finance sign-off that is not given) and FH-046S. Owed by Legal and finance, then Billing and CRM: (1) after D8 is signed, a staff screen that records the approver on hunt_donation_asks (today a row can only be written by hand, and an ask without approved_at and approved_by never opens); (2) one acceptance run against the payment provider in test mode with HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED on in a preview: a gift that succeeds, one that is abandoned, one fully refunded and one partially refunded, each checked against hunt_donation_gifts and the total shown on the play page, with the donor's run unchanged; (3) the record of that run written to docs/hunts/GIFT-ACCEPTANCE.md. FH-046S proved these four states only against a fake client. Production switches stay OFF until this passes.
